title: How I finally paid off my credit cards
body: Hey everyone I wanted to share something that actually helped me tackle my credit card debt. I was really overwhelmed and just kept making minimum payments. I decided to use the avalanche method. I listed all my debts and focused all extra money I could find on the card with the highest interest rate first. It felt slow at first but seeing that balance drop on the highest interest debt was super motivating. Once that one was gone I just kept rolling that momentum onto the next one. It was way more manageable than just throwing money around everywhere.
